# What a list holds: kept at its length, kept for good

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`kept-at-the-length-of-a-list` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](kept-at-the-length-of-a-list.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where a list holds every member of a start that a monotone step takes into itself, what is in the iterate at the list's length is in every iterate, and is the largest class in the start the step preserves. Keeping under every course, along some course, by choice and through a reading are cases.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For a monotone step on classes that takes its start into itself, where a list holds every member of the start: a state in the iterate at the list's length is in the next iterate, so in every iterate, and that iterate is the largest class inside the start that the step preserves. With no list, a class inside the start that the step preserves lies in every iterate. (`Becoming.Iteration.iter`, `Becoming.Iteration.MonotoneStep`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_persists`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_iff_all`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_largest`, `Becoming.Iteration.postfixed_in_iter`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_pred`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_within`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_postfixed`, `Becoming.Iteration.extend_at_places`, `Becoming.Iteration.not_iter_of_not_succ`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_iff_stages`, `Becoming.remove_mem`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. For a monotone step whose start is the step applied to the class of everything, where a list of length n + 1 holds every state, a state in iterate n is in iterate n + 1. (`Becoming.Iteration.iter_shift`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_persists_from_all`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Where a list holds every state at which a requirement holds: it holds throughout a relation's closure from a state exactly where that state is in the iterate at the list's length, from the requirement, of the step asking it here and every successor in the class. So for the kernel of every process and for lasting, under every admissible disturbance, for as many steps as the list is long; one step sooner where a list of length n + 1 holds every state. (`Becoming.regionStep`, `Becoming.held_iff_iter`, `Becoming.held_iff_iter_pred_length`, `Becoming.Viability.kernel_iff_iter`, `Becoming.Viability.kernel_iff_iter_pred_length`, `Becoming.Lasting.iter_region_iff_lasts`, `Becoming.Lasting.kernel_iff_lasts_length`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Where a list holds every configuration: from where a course of as many steps as the list is long starts, some step leads to where another such course starts, and courses of every length start there. (`Becoming.Parting.courseStep`, `Becoming.Parting.iter_iff_continues`, `Becoming.Parting.continues_persists`, `Becoming.Parting.continues_any`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Where a list holds every configuration within a guard: a configuration viable for as many steps as the list is long has an enabled move all of whose outcomes are viable for as many; such configurations form a closed set; and being viable for that many steps is being viable for every number of steps, and is lying in some closed set. (`Becoming.GuardHorizon.choiceStep`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.iter_iff_viable`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.viable_persists`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.viable_closed`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.viable_iff_every_horizon`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.viable_iff_closed`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.closed_viable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Through a reading: where a list holds every code whose class lies within the guard, and after each usable move from the class of such a code every class seen is exactly the class of some code, the class of a code is kept for as many steps as the list is long exactly where it lies in a family of classes within the guard, each with a usable move after which every class seen is in the family. (`Becoming.Viability.InClosedFamily`, `Becoming.Viability.readingStep`, `Becoming.Viability.iter_iff_kept`, `Becoming.Viability.coded_kept_iff_closed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. For a monotone step whose start lies inside its own step, each iterate lies inside the next. For a proposition G, the step commutes with G when, for every class W and state z, if z is in the step of the class of states at which G follows from 'W gives G', then G follows from 'z in the step of W gives G'. The step on what gives G holds of a class X at z where 'z in the step of the states at which X gives G' gives G. Where the step commutes with G, z in an iterate gives G exactly where z is in the same iterate of the step on what gives G, begun from the states at which membership in the start gives G. Where it does and a list holds every state at which membership in the start gives G (a list of every state does), if y in the iterate at the list's length gives G so does y in the next; and where G is that y is in that iterate, y in any iterate is in it. Where it does, a list of length n + 1 holds every state, G is that y is in iterate n, and the states at which membership in the start gives G are exactly those at which one step on what gives G, from every state, holds, y in any iterate is in iterate n. (`Becoming.Iteration.givesStep`, `Becoming.Iteration.CommutesWithImplication`, `Becoming.Iteration.imp_iff_iter_gives`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_gives_persists`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_shortens`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_within_length`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_within_pred_length`, `Becoming.Iteration.iter_succ`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Reaching a target along a relation commutes with every proposition. So where a list of length n + 1 holds every state, a state that reaches the target within any number of steps reaches it within n, and the relation's closure from a state meets the target exactly where the state reaches it within n steps; for a process, what can be reached is reached by at most n moves. (`Becoming.reachStep`, `Becoming.reach_commutes`, `Becoming.reach_within_pred_length`, `Becoming.closure_iff_reach_within`, `Becoming.Reaching.iter_reach_iff_trace`, `Becoming.Reaching.trace_within_pred_length`, `Becoming.Reaching.possible_iff_within_of_pred_le`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Where a list holds every state, every monotone step commutes with falsity: a state in the iterate one past the list's length of a rising chain cannot be refuted to be in the iterate at its length, and is in it where that follows from its double negation. That this held outright for every monotone step on a one-state type, from the empty start, would decide every proposition. (`Becoming.Iteration.commutes_false`, `Becoming.Iteration.rise_not_not`, `Becoming.Iteration.rise_of_stable`, `Becoming.Iteration.singleton_rise_needs_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. A level of the losing step (the guard fails, or every enabled move has an outcome one level lower), from where the guard fails, refutes viability for that many steps. Worded with a disjunction (each move cannot be taken or has such an outcome), with the configurations and the moves each on a list, a level one above the number of listed configurations comes down to it. (`Becoming.GuardHorizon.loseStep`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.not_viable_of_loss`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lostStep`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_implies_lose`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_iff_lose`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_not_viable`, `Becoming.gather_listed`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_commutes`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_shortens`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. That such a level comes down for every process on three configurations with one move, worded with the implication, would decide every proposition; on two configurations with every guard, every negation. Worded with the disjunction and moves not on a list, it would give the limited principle of omniscience. These are implications from a supposed shortening; they refute nothing. (`Becoming.GuardHorizon.lose_shortening_decides`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lose_shortening_decides_negations`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lost_shortening_distributes`, `Becoming.GuardHorizon.lpo_of_distributes`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. Stages of telling apart along a relation: where a list holds every pair a class relates, a pair that passes inquiry at the list's length passes it at every stage; and where the class is also symmetric, that is lying in the core. (`Becoming.inquiryStep`, `Becoming.iter_iff_inquiry`, `Becoming.inquiry_iff_all`, `Becoming.core_iff_inquiry`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
13. Where a list holds every configuration: a configuration had after exactly as many steps as the list is long is had after exactly n steps for every n, and for a determined law this is returning and its failure is being drawn; and some run stays within a guard from a configuration exactly where it is in the iterate, at the list's length from the guard, of the step asking the guard here and some successor in the class. (`Becoming.Branching.predStep`, `Becoming.Branching.iter_iff_reachable`, `Becoming.Branching.reachable_iff_all`, `Becoming.Law.returns_iff_reachable_count`, `Becoming.Law.drawn_iff_not_reachable_count`, `Becoming.Viability.keepStep`, `Becoming.Viability.keepable_iff_count`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and finite runs; its declarations reach the grammar.
14. Where a list holds every configuration within a guard, along no run does what is possible within a fixed number of steps, read as the configurations within the guard, keep widening. This stands beside the law and is not a case of it: its proof is a call of the older statement for a list that holds the whole possible from a run's start, and uses no declaration of the iteration. (`Becoming.Reaching.guarded_not_keepsWidening`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each statement names its list: the members of the start, the configurations within the guard, the codes of classes within it, the pairs a class relates, every configuration, or the configurations and the moves. That an actual situation has such a list is supplied with each application.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- A quantity drawn down, a share, a lock, or the time at which a reading comes: none is in these statements.
- One statement with both outcomes of a course that has a choice, a reading and a bound on the ending side.
- That one way of selecting is placed against another; the statement on widening is of the configurations within a guard reachable within a fixed number of moves from each configuration of a run.
- That the codes of a reading are the classes actually reached, or that every class seen has a code: both are supplied with each application, and no instance of the reading law is built in the package.
- That a level of the losing step fails to come down: the theorems of deciding are implications from a supposed coming down, and refute nothing.
- That the number of an iterate is a time: it counts applications of the step. In several of the cases it is a number of steps or moves of a course; no statement of the law itself reads it so.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

A law of the formal model. Reading it onto an actual situation asks two recognitions that the theorems do not give: that what lies within the guard is finitely many configurations that a list can hold, and that the keeping at hand is the iterate of a monotone step from the guard. The reading of the steps as keeping under every course, along some course, by a choice and through a reading is the package's own; the reading onto selections that use up what sustains them is the AI's and is not made here.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [where-a-run-goes-on](where-a-run-goes-on.md). Within finitely many configurations a run is a course into a return; here a course as long as the list goes on, as a case of the law.
- related, not a proved adapter: [conditions-kept-together](conditions-kept-together.md). The step of keeping along some course, with no list; here keepable at a list's length.
- related, not a proved adapter: [tests-fix-likeness-where-determined](tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md). Likeness to depth at the number of pairs is a case of the law.
- related, not a proved adapter: [identification-where-runs-part](identification-where-runs-part.md). Its ninth law, a course as long as the list, is now a call of the law.

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 22 November 2026: added, on board row FM (one law of what a list holds, and its cases), in the direction Ren gave on 21 November 2026 (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-21-a-full-map-with-its-centre.md: a full map with formal link proof, done elegantly, with its centre). AI-written (Claude Fable, board row FM). The law began as an exact bound for a choice against every outcome, was said once for a monotone step after a reader saw that only monotonicity was used, and the ending side was said once after three inductions on places had been written and each was found by a reader to be the law's own. Parting.continues_persists, continues_any, GuardHorizon.closed_viable and Tolerance.kept_set keep their statements and became calls; AlikeTo.steady_within and alike_iff_alikeTo_pairs lost four premises (record tests-fix-likeness-where-determined). Briefs, builds, readers' returns and what was expected before each run: study folder fm-the-law-of-what-a-list-holds-2026-11-22. Bound to core run 20261121T212524.793950Z.
- 22 November 2026, board row FM: the next step no longer names Branching.reach_within_listed, which lost its two unneeded premises in place in the landing that followed this one (record reaching-before-and-after-a-juncture). No law changed. Bound to core run 20261121T223556.393134Z for ReachableRanges.lean, where one docstring sentence about that theorem changed.
- 22 November 2026, board row FM: two corrections of the telling, found by readers of the atlas entry for this law (board row DJ, study folder the-list-law-on-the-atlas-2026-11-22) and set against the Lean by the session that holds row FM. Law 7 said that a list holds every state; the Lean asks a list of every state at which membership in the start gives G (Iteration.iter_gives_persists, iter_shortens, iter_within_length), which a list of every state meets; iter_within_pred_length does ask a list of every state. Law 14 (Reaching.guarded_not_keepsWidening) stands beside the law: its proof calls Reaching.not_keepsWidening_of_listed and no declaration of PredicateIteration. Added to what is not shown: the number of an iterate is not read as a time by the law. A reader who took no part then set the corrected places against the Lean and passed them, and recommended two more mends, made with them: law 7 now tells every declaration it lists (each iterate inside the next; the state in the definition of commuting; the equivalence with the iterates of the step on what gives G; the step on what gives G said in words, at the coordinating session's remark; and the form with a list of n + 1 members, with its further premise), and law 3's English says, as its Chinese did, that lasting is for as many steps as the list is long. No Lean changed; the title is unchanged. AI-written (Claude Fable, board row FM).
